# Upstream artifact extraction

SmartSession, SudoPolicy and TimeFramePolicy come from erc7579/smartsessions, pinned commit f5aaf867f7e22f3b9d746ce6f404f3a56833757f.

These JSON files retain the original ABI and creation bytecode; metadata and duplicate deployed bytecode were removed for review size. Each records the SHA-256 of the complete original artifact. No upstream bytecode is modified. SmartSession is a Rhinestone/Biconomy project; BAG claims no authorship, audit or relicensing.

The upstream README declares AGPL-3.0. Corresponding complete source, notices and individual SPDX declarations are available at https://github.com/erc7579/smartsessions/tree/f5aaf867f7e22f3b9d746ce6f404f3a56833757f . The AGPL text is included as AGPL-3.0.txt. Individual policy sources may carry their own SPDX license.

Original artifacts:
- https://github.com/erc7579/smartsessions/blob/f5aaf867f7e22f3b9d746ce6f404f3a56833757f/artifacts/SmartSession/SmartSession.json
- https://github.com/erc7579/smartsessions/blob/f5aaf867f7e22f3b9d746ce6f404f3a56833757f/artifacts/SudoPolicy/SudoPolicy.json
- https://github.com/erc7579/smartsessions/blob/f5aaf867f7e22f3b9d746ce6f404f3a56833757f/artifacts/TimeFramePolicy/TimeFramePolicy.json
